button.label: Insert Citation
button.supertip: Search your Citograph library or this document's traveling library. Insert grouped citations with page locators, prefixes, and suffixes.

button.label: Edit Citation
button.supertip: Change grouped sources, page numbers, author suppression, and citation text around the source.

button.label: Update Citations
button.supertip: Recalculate citation order, numbering, year disambiguation, and every Citograph bibliography in the active document.

button.label: Insert Bibliography
button.supertip: Insert a bibliography at the end of the document. Italics, numbering, and hanging indentation are preserved.

button.label: Refresh Source Metadata
button.supertip: Refresh source snapshots from your Citograph desktop library, then update citations and references.

button.label: Style Studio
button.supertip: Create styles with the visual builder or Python Lab. Preview, save versions and apply them to Word.

button.label: Refresh Styles
button.supertip: Reload saved Citograph styles. Select a style to apply its latest saved version to this document.

button.label: Traveling Library
button.supertip: Browse metadata embedded in Citograph citation fields. The sources travel with your Word file and with copied citation fields.

button.label: Import to Citograph
button.supertip: Bring sources cited in this document into the desktop library. Existing references are skipped.

button.label: Export Traveling Library
button.supertip: Save document sources as CSL JSON, RIS, or BibTeX.

button.label: Migrate EndNote
button.supertip: Inspect embedded EndNote references, import sources and create a new Word copy with editable Citograph citations and bibliography.

button.label: Document Check
button.supertip: Find missing source metadata, damaged citations, duplicate field IDs, and bibliography status.

button.label: Convert to Plain Text
button.supertip: Detach only Citograph citations and bibliography controls. Save a document copy first.
